page: Google Cloud Platform m4n-ultramem-224 is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the m4n server family. It features 224 dedicated vCPUs and 5952.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 26.57 GB per vCPU. This configuration is designed for memory-intensive workloads that require massive RAM capacity alongside substantial compute resources.

This server type does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached storage options. Additionally, there are zero integrated GPUs, making it unsuitable for hardware-accelerated graphics or GPU-based machine learning workloads. There are also zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this instance.

From a cost perspective, the m4n-ultramem-224 represents a high-end hardware class with extreme resource density, resulting in a high qualitative cost profile that reflects its massive memory allocation. It is designed for large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning systems, and massive data analytics workloads that must keep entire datasets in system memory to avoid storage latency.
